purpose: Assess original A technical entry information against matched earlier market times; not deploy a new signal
data: Only authorized existing capsule plus its warmup; no restricted tail
signal_population: Frozen50 original A economic signals; report filled27 and unfilled23 separately

reference_selection.volatility: Use closed-hour ATR14/close, reference-to-signal ratio in [0.8,1.25]
reference_selection.selection: Minimum SHA256 of canonical [20260909,economic_signal_id,reference_time] among eligible candidates; no outcome access
reference_selection.no_match: Report unmatched; no relaxed thresholds, wider dates or replacement search
reference_selection.reuse: Reference reuse allowed only if recorded; shared reference and overlapping label windows are one dependence group

outcomes.fixed_horizon: 6H gross reference movement and BASE10/5 costed movement reported separately
outcomes.policy: ORIGINAL exit only; anchor relative stop/target distances at reference entry, preserve source mode and timeout; explicit synthetic reference plan, never actual signal
outcomes.risk: Reference plan BASE denominator computed solely from reference-time plan and frozen costs; do not copy future realized risk
outcomes.missing: Null/censored, never zero; do not replace missing controls after reading outcomes

required_before_execution: Audit availability and closed-hour state mapping for all selected references
Freeze selected reference IDs and input hashes before resolving outcomes
Verify synthetic reference geometry and shared ORIGINAL resolver parity
Keep no-match and dependency records in the final report
budget: One registered matching rule and one immutable result; no threshold sweep or winner selection
failure_branch: Weak or insufficient evidence ends this hypothesis; no extension filter activation
limitations: Matched historical times are observational controls, not randomized causal evidence or independent OOS
